def test_csv_rows():
    # Basic single field
    assert csv_rows("a") == [["a"]], (csv_rows("a"), [["a"]])
    
    # Basic multiple fields
    assert csv_rows("a,b,c") == [["a", "b", "c"]], (csv_rows("a,b,c"), [["a", "b", "c"]])
    
    # Multiple rows with LF
    assert csv_rows("a,b\nc,d") == [["a", "b"], ["c", "d"]], (csv_rows("a,b\nc,d"), [["a", "b"], ["c", "d"]])
    
    # Multiple rows with CRLF
    assert csv_rows("a,b\r\nc,d") == [["a", "b"], ["c", "d"]], (csv_rows("a,b\r\nc,d"), [["a", "b"], ["c", "d"]])
    
    # Mixed line endings
    assert csv_rows("a,b\nc,d\r\ne,f") == [["a", "b"], ["c", "d"], ["e", "f"]], (csv_rows("a,b\nc,d\r\ne,f"), [["a", "b"], ["c", "d"], ["e", "f"]])
    
    # Quoted field with comma
    assert csv_rows('"a,b",c') == [["a,b", "c"]], (csv_rows('"a,b",c'), [["a,b", "c"]])
    
    # Quoted field with newline (LF)
    assert csv_rows('"a\nb",c') == [["a\nb", "c"]], (csv_rows('"a\nb",c'), [["a\nb", "c"]])
    
    # Quoted field with newline (CRLF)
    assert csv_rows('"a\r\nb",c') == [["a\r\nb", "c"]], (csv_rows('"a\r\nb",c'), [["a\r\nb", "c"]])
    
    # Doubled quotes as escaped quote
    assert csv_rows('"a""b",c') == [["a\"b", "c"]], (csv_rows('"a""b",c'), [["a\"b", "c"]])
    
    # Multiple doubled quotes
    assert csv_rows('"a""""b",c') == [["a\"\"b", "c"]], (csv_rows('"a""""b",c'), [["a\"\"b", "c"]])
    
    # Empty fields
    assert csv_rows("a,,c") == [["a", "", "c"]], (csv_rows("a,,c"), [["a", "", "c"]])
    
    # Empty quoted field
    assert csv_rows('""') == [[""]], (csv_rows('""'), [[""]])
    
    # Empty quoted field with other fields
    assert csv_rows('a,"",c') == [["a", "", "c"]], (csv_rows('a,"",c'), [["a", "", "c"]])
    
    # Trailing newline
    assert csv_rows("a,b\n") == [["a", "b"]], (csv_rows("a,b\n"), [["a", "b"]])
    
    # Trailing CRLF
    assert csv_rows("a,b\r\n") == [["a", "b"]], (csv_rows("a,b\r\n"), [["a", "b"]])
    
    # Multiple trailing newlines
    assert csv_rows("a,b\n\n") == [["a", "b"], []], (csv_rows("a,b\n\n"), [["a", "b"], []])
    
    # Empty input
    assert csv_rows("") == [], (csv_rows(""), [])
    
    # Only newlines
    assert csv_rows("\n") == [[]], (csv_rows("\n"), [[]])
    
    # Only CRLF
    assert csv_rows("\r\n") == [[]], (csv_rows("\r\n"), [[]])
    
    # Quoted field with comma and newline
    assert csv_rows('"a,b\nc",d') == [["a,b\nc", "d"]], (csv_rows('"a,b\nc",d'), [["a,b\nc", "d"]])
    
    # Quoted field with CRLF inside
    assert csv_rows('"a,b\r\nc",d') == [["a,b\r\nc", "d"]], (csv_rows('"a,b\r\nc",d'), [["a,b\r\nc", "d"]])
    
    # Quoted field with escaped quote and comma
    assert csv_rows('"a""b,c",d') == [["a\"b,c", "d"]], (csv_rows('"a""b,c",d'), [["a\"b,c", "d"]])
    
    # Quoted field with escaped quote and newline
    assert csv_rows('"a""b\nc",d') == [["a\"b\nc", "d"]], (csv_rows('"a""b\nc",d'), [["a\"b\nc", "d"]])
    
    # Multiple quoted fields
    assert csv_rows('"a,b","c,d"') == [["a,b", "c,d"]], (csv_rows('"a,b","c,d"'), [["a,b", "c,d"]])
    
    # Quoted field at end
    assert csv_rows("a,\"b,c\"") == [["a", "b,c"]], (csv_rows("a,\"b,c\""), [["a", "b,c"]])
    
    # Quoted field at start
    assert csv_rows("\"a,b\",c") == [["a,b", "c"]], (csv_rows("\"a,b\",c"), [["a,b", "c"]])
    
    # Field with spaces
    assert csv_rows("a b,c d") == [["a b", "c d"]], (csv_rows("a b,c d"), [["a b", "c d"]])
    
    # Quoted field with spaces
    assert csv_rows('"a b","c d"') == [["a b", "c d"]], (csv_rows('"a b","c d"'), [["a b", "c d"]])
    
    # Multiple rows with quoted fields
    assert csv_rows('"a,b",c\n"d,e",f') == [["a,b", "c"], ["d,e", "f"]], (csv_rows('"a,b",c\n"d,e",f'), [["a,b", "c"], ["d,e", "f"]])
    
    # CRLF with quoted fields
    assert csv_rows('"a,b",c\r\n"d,e",f') == [["a,b", "c"], ["d,e", "f"]], (csv_rows('"a,b",c\r\n"d,e",f'), [["a,b", "c"], ["d,e", "f"]])
    
    # Quoted field with only escaped quotes
    assert csv_rows('""""') == [["\""]], (csv_rows('""""'), [["\""]])
    
    # Quoted field with multiple escaped quotes
    assert csv_rows('"""a"""') == [["\"a\""]], (csv_rows('"""a"""'), [["\"a\""]])
    
    # Empty row in middle
    assert csv_rows("a,b\n\nc,d") == [["a", "b"], [], ["c", "d"]], (csv_rows("a,b\n\nc,d"), [["a", "b"], [], ["c", "d"]])
    
    # CRLF empty row in middle
    assert csv_rows("a,b\r\n\r\nc,d") == [["a", "b"], [], ["c", "d"]], (csv_rows("a,b\r\n\r\nc,d"), [["a", "b"], [], ["c", "d"]])
    
    # Quoted field with CRLF and escaped quote
    assert csv_rows('"a""\r\nb",c') == [["a\"\r\nb", "c"]], (csv_rows('"a""\r\nb",c'), [["a\"\r\nb", "c"]])
    
    # Multiple fields with various quoting
    assert csv_rows('a,"b,c",d,"e""f"') == [["a", "b,c", "d", "e\"f"]], (csv_rows('a,"b,c",d,"e""f"'), [["a", "b,c", "d", "e\"f"]])
    
    # Trailing comma
    assert csv_rows("a,b,") == [["a", "b", ""]], (csv_rows("a,b,"), [["a", "b", ""]])
    
    # Leading comma
    assert csv_rows(",a,b") == [["", "a", "b"]], (csv_rows(",a,b"), [["", "a", "b"]])
    
    # Quoted empty with trailing comma
    assert csv_rows('""') == [[""]], (csv_rows('""'), [[""]])
    
    # Complex multi-line quoted field
    assert csv_rows('"line1\nline2\nline3",b') == [["line1\nline2\nline3", "b"]], (csv_rows('"line1\nline2\nline3",b'), [["line1\nline2\nline3", "b"]])

def csv_rows(text):
    """
    Parse RFC 4180 CSV text and return a list of rows, each a list of string fields.
    Handles quoted fields with commas/newlines, doubled quotes as escaped quotes,
    and CRLF or LF line endings.
    """
    rows = []
    i = 0
    n = len(text)
    
    while i < n:
        # Start a new row
        row = []
        while True:
            # Parse a field
            if i < n and text[i] == '"':
                # Quoted field
                i += 1  # skip opening quote
                field_chars = []
                while i < n:
                    if text[i] == '"':
                        if i + 1 < n and text[i + 1] == '"':
                            # Doubled quote: escaped quote
                            field_chars.append('"')
                            i += 2
                        else:
                            # Closing quote
                            i += 1  # skip closing quote
                            break
                    else:
                        field_chars.append(text[i])
                        i += 1
                row.append(''.join(field_chars))
            else:
                # Unquoted field
                field_chars = []
                while i < n and text[i] != ',' and text[i] != '\r' and text[i] != '\n':
                    field_chars.append(text[i])
                    i += 1
                row.append(''.join(field_chars))
            
            # After field, check what's next
            if i < n and text[i] == ',':
                # Comma: next field in same row
                i += 1  # skip comma
                continue
            elif i < n and text[i] == '\r':
                # CRLF or CR line ending
                i += 1
                if i < n and text[i] == '\n':
                    i += 1  # skip \n in CRLF
                break
            elif i < n and text[i] == '\n':
                # LF line ending
                i += 1
                break
            else:
                # End of input
                break
        
        rows.append(row)
    
    return rows

def csv_rows(text):
    """
    Parses RFC 4180 CSV text and returns a list of rows, each a list of string fields.
    Handles quoted fields containing commas and newlines, doubled quotes as escaped quotes,
    and CRLF or LF line endings.
    """
    rows = []
    current_row = []
    current_field = []
    in_quotes = False
    i = 0
    n = len(text)
    
    while i < n:
        char = text[i]
        
        if in_quotes:
            if char == '"':
                # Check if next char is also a quote (escaped quote)
                if i + 1 < n and text[i + 1] == '"':
                    current_field.append('"')
                    i += 2
                else:
                    # End of quoted field
                    in_quotes = False
                    i += 1
            else:
                current_field.append(char)
                i += 1
        else:
            if char == '"':
                # Start of quoted field
                in_quotes = True
                i += 1
            elif char == ',':
                # End of field, start new field
                current_row.append(''.join(current_field))
                current_field = []
                i += 1
            elif char == '\r':
                # Handle CRLF or CR
                if i + 1 < n and text[i + 1] == '\n':
                    # CRLF
                    current_row.append(''.join(current_field))
                    current_field = []
                    rows.append(current_row)
                    current_row = []
                    i += 2
                else:
                    # Lone CR
                    current_row.append(''.join(current_field))
                    current_field = []
                    rows.append(current_row)
                    current_row = []
                    i += 1
            elif char == '\n':
                # LF
                current_row.append(''.join(current_field))
                current_field = []
                rows.append(current_row)
                current_row = []
                i += 1
            else:
                current_field.append(char)
                i += 1
    
    # After loop, add the last field and row if there's any content
    if current_field or current_row:
        current_row.append(''.join(current_field))
        rows.append(current_row)
    
    return rows

    i = 0
    n = len(text)
    
    while i < n:
        row = []
        while True:
            # Start of a field
            if i < n and text[i] == '"':
                # Quoted field
                i += 1  # skip opening quote
                field_chars = []
                while i < n:
                    if text[i] == '"':
                        if i + 1 < n and text[i + 1] == '"':
                            # Escaped quote
                            field_chars.append('"')
                            i += 2
                        else:
                            # Closing quote
                            i += 1
                            break
                    else:
                        field_chars.append(text[i])
                        i += 1
                row.append(''.join(field_chars))
            else:
                # Unquoted field
                field_chars = []
                while i < n and text[i] != ',' and text[i] != '\r' and text[i] != '\n':
                    field_chars.append(text[i])
                    i += 1
                row.append(''.join(field_chars))
            
            # After the field, check what comes next
            if i >= n:
                # End of text
                break
            elif text[i] == ',':
                # Next field in same row
                i += 1  # skip comma
                continue
            elif text[i] == '\r':
                # CRLF line ending
                if i + 1 < n and text[i + 1] == '\n':
                    i += 2  # skip CRLF
                else:
                    i += 1  # skip just CR
                break
            elif text[i] == '\n':
                # LF line ending
                i += 1
                break
            else:
                # Shouldn't happen in valid CSV, but break to be safe
                break
        
        rows.append(row)
        
        # Skip any trailing empty lines? No, we just continue the outer loop.
        # If i >= n, the outer while will terminate.
    
    return rows
